summary: The Department of Children & Family Services reviewed the draft environmental impact statement for the FA Route 23 Lincoln Highway project and determined it would have no negative environmental effect on any facilities under its jurisdiction. The Department offered no objections, conditions, or substantive comments beyond this brief clearance statement.
complaint_summary: The Department of Children & Family Services reviewed the environmental statement for FA Route 23 and found the proposed project has no negative environmental effect on any of its facilities.

statement.text:
The above statement has been reviewed in this Department and the proposed project has no negative environmental effect on facilities of this Department.
Yours truly,
(Mrs.) Jimi Anne Lawrence
DIRECTOR
